newsitem.title: GREECE: ENDYSI SMALL-CAP IPO ENDS DECEMBER 3.
newsitem.headline: ENDYSI SMALL-CAP IPO ENDS DECEMBER 3.

text.p: Subscriptions to the initial public offering of Endysi SA, a new parallel market listing will end December 3.
Endysi which is a retailer of Lacoste, The Bostonians and Newman apparel and footwear will issue 600,000 common bearer shares at 750 drachmas a share, tapping the market for 450 million drachmas.
The company which also markets the Spanish Springfield brand operates 10 stores in Greece and three in Bulgaria.

Endysi expects sales growth of 18.7 percent this year -- 1.52 billion drachmas -- and pretax profits of 285 million drachmas, up 15.3 percent on 1995. It is going public at a price earnings (P/E) ratio of 6.2.
The IPO proceeds will finance the expansion of its netawork to 20 stores in the next three years.

Issue advisor and lead underwriter is Omega Securities joined by co-underwriters ABN AMRO, General Bank , Interbank, European Popular Bank, National Mortgage Bank, Dorian Bank, NIBID, Alpha Brokerage and Nuntius Securities.
